_doc: Default recipes per class, used by `hdgen.py batch` for items without their own recipe (heads.json, scenes.json, rooms.json, interface.json). {hint} is replaced by the first matching entry of hints (by the item's group: sheet name or room file). batch: which items a batch takes by default.

rooms.prompt: cinematic photograph of {hint}, deep focus, everything in sharp focus, warm light, highly detailed
rooms.negative: cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, blurry, out of focus, depth of field, bokeh, deformed, text, watermark, frame, noise

scenes.prompt: cinematic landscape photograph of {hint}, deep focus, sharp foreground, high detail, 8k
scenes.negative: people, cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, blurry, out of focus, depth of field, bokeh, deformed, text, watermark, frame, noise

heads.prompt: photograph, head and shoulders portrait of {hint}, warm dramatic side light, dark background, 85mm lens, realistic skin texture, sharp focus
heads.negative: cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, blurry, deformed, disfigured, extra limbs, text, watermark, frame

characters.prompt: cinematic photograph, full body of {hint}, sharp focus, highly detailed
characters.negative: cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, blurry, out of focus, depth of field, bokeh, deformed, text, watermark, frame, noise

interface.prompt: photograph of {hint}, relief carving, warm light, highly detailed, sharp focus
interface.negative: letters, cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, blurry, out of focus, depth of field, bokeh, deformed, text, watermark, frame, noise

other.prompt: photograph of {hint}, highly detailed, sharp focus
other.negative: cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, blurry, out of focus, depth of field, bokeh, deformed, text, watermark, frame, noise

room-pieces.prompt: photograph of {hint}, highly detailed, sharp focus
room-pieces.negative: cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, blurry, out of focus, depth of field, bokeh, deformed, text, watermark, frame, noise
